limitations.text: One PIE video (set01/video_0004); the Phase 5 model is trained and evaluated on the same windows (in-sample).
No annotation files, verified conflict labels, verified events or independent scene groups exist: independent evaluation is blocked.
Image-space pixels only; the camera moves; no ego-motion compensation, no metric geometry, no TTC/PET/distance/severity.

The window builder accepts a window only if the target also has its 15 future samples, so windows (and alerts) are conditioned on future track existence; the pipeline is an offline replay, not a causal online system. Inference inputs themselves are history-only (verified by future-scrambling).
Video decoding and detection/tracking were not executed in this environment (no raw video, no OpenCV/Ultralytics, no GPU); Phase 3 results are recorded from the Colab T4 run.

The Phase 5 model verifies the exact window-run manifest hash; regenerating windows creates a new manifest, so the model rejects them (by design). Re-execution is therefore checked for data-file equality and inference uses the reference window run.
CPU-only, one machine; peak memory is the process peak working set; no GPU, no end-to-end real-time measurement.
Phase 7 probabilities are null; categories and Phase 8 thresholds are unvalidated engineering configuration.
Alerts are properties of a heuristic on one in-sample video; most close by evidence loss (pair no longer observed), not by risk subsiding.

The recorded full run (pie_video_0004_full) was executed with the code revision BEFORE four additions: enriched Phase 8 provenance, the execution_mode / input-hash fields in the manifest, the CPU-name and RAM fields, and torch routed through the guarded Phase 5 module. Execution mode, attribution and input hashes for that run were derived afterwards with `attribute` and `verify-run` (read-only, no re-measurement); the new code paths are demonstrated by the inference replay run and the tests.

tests/phase2/test_ttc_masks.py::test_ttc_occupancy_mask_collapses_agent_dimension fails (UnboundLocalError: TTC_mask, utils/Interaction.py:173). Verified pre-existing: it fails identically at Phase 5 commit afdf822 and utils/ and tests/phase2/ are byte-identical since. It is baseline code unrelated to Phases 3-9 and was not modified.

Metadata-only differences between Phase 9 and the committed Phase 8 events: inference replay differs in 3 provenance keys (phase5_predictions_sha256, phase9_execution_mode, phase9_stage); the recorded full run differs in 10 (its S8 provenance predates the enrichment). Event ids, alert ids, pairs, transitions, ordering, risk values, masks and every non-provenance field are exactly equal. No scientific content differs.

Peak memory is the process peak working set from the Windows API (psutil is not installed); it is monotone, process-wide and includes the benchmark repetitions. S3 time (0.52 s) is artifact validation, not perception. No local YOLO or video-decoding time exists. Phase 4-8 offline-batch throughput (33.2 frames of video per second of processing) is not raw-video end-to-end FPS.
